financeSummary.headline: Market Recap - Week of February 15, 2026
financeSummary.summary: The S&P 500 slipped 1.4% last week as cooling inflation data sparked rate cut optimism while AI capex concerns lingered. Presidents Day Monday means U.S. markets will be closed. Tesla projects vehicle delivery growth of 47-59% for FY2026, while nuclear and tech stocks remain in focus for the week ahead.

Breaking News.text: Warner Bros. reconsidering reopening sale negotiations with Paramount, sources say. This could reshape the media landscape after previous talks stalled. $WBD $PARA
